item.title: About
item.description:
My name is Lindsey Rogers. I love to read, write, and learn knew things.

I have a B.A. from Central Michigan University (2019) in Art History and History, and a M.S.I. in Libraries, Archives, and Knowledge Environments in Society from the University of Michigan School of Information (2026). I am interested in tech, feminism, climate change, society, literacy, information, and preservation. I enjoy science fiction novels, knitting, and going to the beach with my friends. I believe that we can make a better world through collaboration, cooperation, and kindness.

item.title: Beginning
item.description:
Hello World!

My name is Lindsey Rogers, and this is my personal website, The Blazing World. The title comes from the 1666 work of the same name by Margaret Cavendish, Duchess of Newcastle-upon-Tyne. item.content:
Hello World!

My name is Lindsey Rogers, and this is my personal website, The Blazing World. The title comes from the 1666 work of the same name by Margaret Cavendish, Duchess of Newcastle-upon-Tyne. I recently read a novel about her and I was genuinely inspired by the way she would just write whatever she was thinking about and publish it. In our current century, is posted online not (almost) as good as published?

I have a lot of miscellaneous thoughts about my work: librarianship, digital scholarship, feminism; thoughts about interests like politics and environmentalism, about art and books and possibly even knitting. This will function much like a kitchen sink-style blog, as a mix of everything I’m thinking about and work that I am interested in. Perhaps it will even be academically published one day? If Mad Madge can do it, so can I…
